result.response:
The bug has been identified and resolved.

### Root Cause
In [`NodeUtil.mayBeString(Node, boolean)`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_c_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java#L1415-L1421), `allResultsMatch` was incorrectly used instead of `anyResultsMatch`. When evaluating conditional expressions (such as ternary `HOOK` operators or logical `OR` expressions) where only some branches evaluate to strings, `allResultsMatch` returned `false`. This caused constant folding in [`PeepholeFoldConstants`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_c_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/PeepholeFoldConstants.java#L830) to treat the addition operation as purely numeric, illegally reassociating additions such as `(cond ? '1' : 2) + 3 + 4` into `(cond ? '1' : 2) + 7`.

### Fix
In [`NodeUtil.java`](file:///Users/nothing/prometheus_workdir_microstudy/closure_10_group_c_fix/src/com/google/javascript/jscomp/NodeUtil.java#L1415-L1421), updated `mayBeString(Node n, boolean recurse)` to use `anyResultsMatch(n, MAY_BE_STRING_PREDICATE)`.

### Verification
The verification test `mvn test -Dtest=CucumberTest` passes completely (2 scenarios passed, 0 failures). The patch file has been saved as `negative_fix.patch`.
